editorialSummary.heading: What Ector County ISD families should know for 2026-2027
highlights: Staggered first days on August 11 and August 12
Students remain out from December 18 through January 5
February 15 and May 24 are conditional weather make-up dates
paragraphs: Ector County ISD uses a staggered opening. Students in PK-6 and grade 9 begin Tuesday, August 11, 2026. Students in grades 7-8 and 10-12 begin Wednesday, August 12. The last student day for all grades is Thursday, May 27, 2027, and the PDF lists 175 instructional days.

ECISD pairs several holidays with professional-development days to create longer breaks for families. Students are off September 7-8 for Labor Day and professional development, and October 12-13 for the Columbus Day holiday and professional development. Thanksgiving holidays run November 23-27; a November 30 professional-development day keeps students out through Monday.

Students are also out from the December 18 teacher workday through January 5 and return January 6. A March 5 teacher workday leads into Spring Break on March 8-12. The calendar designates February 15 and May 24 as inclement-weather make-up dates, so families should check ECISD announcements before making plans around those days.

faqs.question: When is the first day of school for Ector County ISD in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: ECISD uses staggered first days. PK-6 and grade 9 begin Tuesday, August 11, 2026. Grades 7-8 and 10-12 begin Wednesday, August 12.

faqs.question: When is the last day of school for Ector County ISD?
faqs.answer: The last student day is Thursday, May 27, 2027. It is also the end of the fourth nine-week grading period and second semester.

faqs.question: How many instructional days are on the ECISD calendar?
faqs.answer: The approved calendar lists 175 instructional days. The four grading periods contain 42, 41, 40 and 52 days.

faqs.question: Are ECISD students off September 7 and 8?
faqs.answer: Yes. September 7 is the Labor Day holiday, and September 8 is a student no-school professional-development day. Students return Wednesday, September 9.

faqs.question: How long is the ECISD October student break?
faqs.answer: Students are out Monday, October 12, and Tuesday, October 13, 2026. With the preceding weekend, the break lasts four consecutive calendar days, and classes resume October 14.

faqs.question: When is Ector County ISD Thanksgiving Break?
faqs.answer: Thanksgiving holidays run November 23-27, 2026. The November 30 professional-development day keeps students home one additional weekday, so they return Tuesday, December 1.

faqs.question: When is Ector County ISD winter break in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: ECISD's Winter Holiday Break runs December 21-31, 2026, followed by the January 1-4 Winter Holiday. Because December 18 is a teacher workday and January 5 is a professional-development day, students are continuously out from December 18 through January 5 and return Wednesday, January 6.

faqs.question: When is Ector County ISD Spring Break in 2027?
faqs.answer: The official Spring Break is March 8-12, 2027. March 5 is also a student no-school teacher workday, so students leave after March 4 and return Monday, March 15.

faqs.question: Does ECISD have school on January 18, 2027?
faqs.answer: No. January 18 is the Martin Luther King Jr. holiday, and students return Tuesday, January 19.

faqs.question: Is Good Friday a student holiday in ECISD?
faqs.answer: Yes. Friday, March 26, 2027, is a district holiday. Students return Monday, March 29.

faqs.question: What are ECISD's inclement-weather make-up dates?
faqs.answer: The district calendar designates Monday, February 15, and Monday, May 24, 2027, as inclement-weather make-up dates. Families should check current district announcements to confirm whether students need to attend.

faqs.question: Is there school in ECISD on February 15, 2027?
faqs.answer: The ECISD calendar reserves February 15 as an inclement-weather make-up day. Families should check current district announcements to confirm whether students need to attend.

faqs.question: Is there school in ECISD on May 24, 2027?
faqs.answer: The ECISD calendar reserves May 24 as an inclement-weather make-up day. Families should check current district announcements to confirm whether students need to attend.

faqs.question: When do the ECISD grading periods end?
faqs.answer: The four nine-week grading periods end October 9, December 17, March 4 and May 27.

faqs.question: When does the second semester begin in ECISD?
faqs.answer: The second semester and third grading period begin Wednesday, January 6, 2027, when students return from winter break.

faqs.question: Do OCA and OCTECHS follow this district calendar?
faqs.answer: No. Odessa Collegiate Academy and OCTECHS use a separate early-college calendar with different professional-development dates, college-term dates and weather make-up days.

faqs.question: Does the ECISD calendar include Summer Learning dates?
faqs.answer: The calendar marks Summer Learning dates after the regular school year ends May 27. Families should check ECISD or campus summer-learning information to confirm whether their student is scheduled to attend.

faqs.question: Where can families download the official ECISD calendar?
faqs.answer: Use the official PDF link on this page or visit the Ector County ISD calendar page for the district and OCA/OCTECHS versions.

faqs.question: Can Ector County ISD change the approved calendar?
faqs.answer: Yes. Weather closures may activate one or both make-up dates, and emergency decisions can alter other dates. Current district and campus announcements are the final authority.

Students remain out from the December 18 teacher workday through the January 5 professional-development day and return January 6. The March 5 teacher workday connects to Spring Break March 8-12. February 12 and May 21 are conditional inclement-weather make-up dates, not guaranteed student holidays.
